claims.text: JPMorgan Chase & Co.'s actual common equity tier 1 capital ratio at 2020:Q4 was 13.1%, per Table B.11, row 'Common equity tier 1 capital ratio', column 'Actual 2020:Q4'. This is an actual reported value, not a projection.

claims.text: Under the Federal Reserve's hypothetical severely adverse scenario, JPMorgan Chase & Co.'s projected ending CET1 ratio was 11.9% (column 'Projected 2023:Q1 Ending') and the projected minimum was 10.7% (column 'Projected 2023:Q1 Minimum'). These are hypothetical projections, not actual results.

citations.quotation: Federal Reserve estimates: Severely adverse scenario ... These projections represent hypothetical estimates that involve an economic outcome that is more adverse than expected. The minimum capital ratio presented is for the period 2021:Q1 to 2023:Q1.

counterarguments.text: One might confuse the projected ending ratio (11.9%) with actual values; the table distinguishes 'Actual 2020:Q4' from 'Projected 2023:Q1' columns, and the report explicitly labels the scenario projections as hypothetical.
